name: System J
description: System I + during a buy pause, hold the leading index (SPY/QQQ/SMH) for 21 sessions after SPY's 14-day RSI closes at or below 25, instead of short Treasuries. Acceptance test on the standard data: +4.4 pts overall, every era better (2000-11 +3.4, 2012-19 +7.5, 2020-25 +4.2), held-back +3.5; smaller-fall share 42.3% -> 39.4%, worst fall unchanged. Adopted by the owner.
